get.summary: Returns a single scheduled task having the specified GUID.

parameters.name: scheduledTaskGuid
parameters.description: GUID of the scheduled task you want to retrieve.

404.description: Returns when scheduled task with the specified GUID is not found.

emailConfigurationGuid.description: Stable GUID of the EmailConfigurationInfo — safe for CI/CD serialisation.

emailName.description: Display name of the email as shown in the Email channel UI.

subject.description:
Subject line from the email's content item (EmailContentTypeSpecificFieldValues.EmailSubject).
Null if the email has no published version.

senderEmail.description:
Sender email address resolved via IEmailChannelSenderEmailProvider.
Null if the email has no published version or sender is not configured.

FormAutoresponderOutput.description:
In xByK the autoresponder is an Email channel email assigned to the form.
Subject and sender are resolved from the email's linked content item and
channel sender configuration.

recipientEmails.description: You can specify multiple addresses separated by semicolons.

FormEmailNotificationOutput.description: Not used in xByK. Retained so consumers don't need contract changes.

displayText.description: Not available in xByK — always null.

redirectToUri.description: Not available in xByK — always null.

key.description: The raw stored license key value (base64 envelope).

scheduledTaskIdentifier.description: Identifies the IScheduledTask implementation (registered via RegisterScheduledTask). Replaces the old AssemblyName + Class pair.

executingServerName.description: Server currently or last executing this task.

createdDynamically.description: True if the task configuration row was generated dynamically at runtime rather than authored via the admin UI.
